# Hi there! 👋 I'm Syed Nofel Talha [![Typing SVG](https://readme-typing-svg.demolab.com?font=DM+Mono&size=15&pause=1200&color=D85A30¢er=true&vCenter=true&width=680&lines=Technical+Account+Manager+at+Motive;Fintech+Engineer;Open+Source+Builder)](https://git.io/typing-svg) --- ## 👨‍💻 About Me I'm a passionate engineer with 2.5+ years of fintech experience building core payment systems, combined with a deep interest in low-level systems, game engine development, and compiler engineering. - 🔭 Currently: [Technical Account Manager at Motive](https://www.motive.com) - 💼 Previously: 2.5 years in Fintech (Digital Wallet Systems, Payment Switches, Card Management, Bill Payments) - 🎮 Building my own 3D game engine from scratch ([Ignis](https://github.com/D1abol1cal/Ignis)) - 🛠️ Passionate about: Low-level systems, Compiler engineering, Kernel development, RISC-V chip design - 🎬 Hobbies: Gaming & emulation, Sci-fi/psychological thrillers, Cricket & table tennis - 💡 Open to collaboration and opportunities --- ## ⭐ LATEST PROJECTS | 🔥 **Ignis** | 🎮 **Bunninja** | |---|---| | **[Ignis - 3D Game Engine](https://github.com/D1abol1cal/Ignis)**
A from-scratch 3D game engine with comprehensive explanations. The project is actively developed with core rendering and engine systems already in place. Built with modern graphics APIs and a focus on understanding low-level graphics programming.

![C](https://img.shields.io/badge/C-A8B9CC?style=flat-square&logo=c&logoColor=white) ![C++](https://img.shields.io/badge/C++-00599C?style=flat-square&logo=cplusplus&logoColor=white) ![Objective-C](https://img.shields.io/badge/Objective--C-438EFF?style=flat-square&logo=apple&logoColor=white) ![Vulkan](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vulkan-AC162C?style=flat-square&logo=vulkan&logoColor=white) ![OpenGL](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenGL-FFFFFF?style=flat-square&logo=opengl&logoColor=white) ![DirectX](https://img.shields.io/badge/DirectX-107C10?style=flat-square&logo=windows&logoColor=white) | **[Bunninja - 2D Platformer](https://github.com/D1abol1cal/Bunninja)**
A vibrant 2D pixel art platformer game. Join Bunninja through colorful pixelated worlds filled with obstacles, enemies, and treasures. A fun project showcasing game mechanics and pixel art aesthetics.
